# SetSamplerFilterMag 〔BlitzLLVM〕

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Textures](Blitz3D-Textures)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SetSamplerFilterMag:Void sampler:Int32, mode:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sampler` | In | Int32 | required | The sampler to change. |
| `mode` | In | Int32 | required | The filter mode from the table above. |

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Chooses how texels are read when a texture is drawn bigger than it is (magnification). This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals read every texture with the settings of its flags and do not have samplers.


| Mode | Result |
|---|---|
| 0 | Nearest: the texel that is closest, which shows blocks. |
| 1 | Linear: blends the texels around the point, the default. |

## Differences

* The mode has to be 0 or 1, other values stop the program with an error.
